scope: P2-RM0 portfolio and risk MEASUREMENT definitions. Crypto / Binance spot only. Measurement only: no metric triggers, sizes, limits, selects or optimizes anything. Never derived from or tuned on strategy outcomes, H01-H07, the 48 planned trials, PAPER-R1 or W3.

classes.MEASURED: a value read from a sealed public market-data record (bid, ask, depth level, candle close, timestamp)
classes.DERIVED: deterministic arithmetic on MEASURED values and on position-contract inputs (returns, vol, correlation, beta, exposure, shares, ages)
classes.ASSUMED: an input or modelling choice not measured by RM0 (hypothetical capital, sqrt-time scaling, BTC/USDT as the BTC reference, the reference-notional exposure basis); any composite that uses one is ASSUMED
classes.POLICY: a research flag threshold (policy_v1.json); uncalibrated, never an action, never a definition of a metric
classes.UNAVAILABLE: value null plus a reason; never 0

composition_rule: a composite takes the weakest class of its parts in the order MEASURED < DERIVED < ASSUMED; any UNAVAILABLE part makes it UNAVAILABLE; POLICY applies only to threshold fields
rounding: floats are rounded to 12 significant digits (p2_research.execution.schema.rnd), canonical JSON with sorted keys

w3.snapshot_time: a snapshot time inside W3 is refused (W3SealedError)
w3.market_observations: a book or depth record whose available_at lies inside W3 is masked (treated as absent, flag w3_masked_record); a candle whose interval starts before the W3 end is masked (never used, counted as w3_masked)
w3.structural_metadata: run-chain facts and the universe epoch effective at T (announced by a lifecycle record) are structural metadata, used exactly as in P2-C / P2-X; they carry no price or outcome

pit: every input used at snapshot time T satisfies available_at_ms <= T; candles additionally require close_ms < T; accessors refuse t > T (PITViolation) and re-assert availability of every returned element

returns.definition: r_k = ln(close_k / close_{k-1}) for consecutive 15m bars k-1, k, both CLOSED (close_ms < T), available (available_at_ms <= T) and not W3-masked
returns.window: the declared number L of most recent expected returns: bar opens E-(L-1)*bar_ms .. E, where E = floor((T - bar_ms) / bar_ms) * bar_ms is the open of the last bar closed by T
returns.gap_rule: no bridging, no interpolation, no fill: a return exists only when both consecutive bars are present

states.INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY: present returns < declared min_obs (includes history before the collector start or masked by W3); value null
states.STALE_INPUT: the bar with open E is not available at T (fetch not yet visible); computed on the available bars
states.GAP_AFFECTED: a bar strictly between the first and last present bar of the window is missing

exposure.basis: reference notional n_i from the position contract (quantity x reference price, quote currency); class DERIVED. Mark-to-market at T (quantity x PIT mid at T) is reported separately and never replaces the basis
exposure.long: sum of n_i over long positions
exposure.short: sum of n_i over conceptual short positions (short is NOT authorized; any short position sets the flag short_side_conceptual_not_authorized)
exposure.count: number of positions after duplicate-identity normalization
exposure.breakdowns: gross and net by symbol, by tier (universe epoch known at T; a symbol outside it -> bucket NOT_IN_UNIVERSE_AT_T), by venue and by quote currency
exposure.flat: G = 0 is a valid known zero (P0); every weight-based metric is UNAVAILABLE(flat_portfolio), never 0

heat.purpose: ex-ante size of the open book relative to an ASSUMED hypothetical capital. It is NOT a realized-loss breaker and is NOT defined from any B3 limit (B3 daily/weekly/drawdown limits are realized-loss circuit breakers; heat is an exposure measure; no B3 number appears in this definition)

inputs.measured_exposure: G and |s_i| (DERIVED from the position contract)
inputs.volatility: sigma_1d_i = RM0-VOL long-lookback 15m sigma x sqrt(96) (DERIVED; sqrt-time scaling ASSUMED)
inputs.capital: C, ASSUMED hypothetical capital (policy_v1.json hypothetical_capital); never a private balance, never read from any account

outputs.vol_heat_ccy: V = sum |s_i| sigma_1d_i, quote currency: sum of standalone one-sigma one-day moves with NO diversification credit (equivalent to all correlations = 1); DERIVED (scaling ASSUMED)
outputs.exceeds_capital: structural flag G > C (spot without margin cannot hold more than its capital); STRUCTURAL, not POLICY

heat.refusal: V and H_V require sigma for EVERY position; otherwise null with state INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY or UNAVAILABLE and the per-position coverage; never a partial sum presented as complete
heat.thresholds: research flags only, POLICY/ASSUMED in policy_v1.json

concentration.weights: w_i = |s_i| / G over symbols (one position per instrument after normalization)
concentration.top3_share: sum of the three largest w_i (all if fewer than three)
concentration.effective_n_notional: 1 / HHI: a NOTIONAL-ONLY count; it ignores correlation, volatility and liquidity and is never presented as a number of independent bets
concentration.tier_concentration: tier shares and HHI over tier-aggregated gross

volatility.estimator: sample standard deviation (n-1) of RM0-RET returns
volatility.daily_equivalent: sigma_1d = sigma_15m_long x sqrt(96); the sqrt-time (iid) scaling is ASSUMED
volatility.vol_ratio: sigma_15m_short / sigma_15m_long (vol-spike primitive); null when either is null or sigma_long = 0
volatility.high_vol: position flag when sigma_15m_long_i >= policy multiple x the median sigma_15m_long of the universe known at T (median over symbols with a value; requires at least half of the universe)
volatility.portfolio_vol_proxy: sqrt(s' Sigma s) x sqrt(96) in quote currency, Sigma the RM0-COV sample covariance; only under the RM0-COV condition, else UNAVAILABLE

correlation.estimator: Pearson correlation of pairwise-aligned RM0-RET returns (bars where both have a return)
correlation.confidence: Fisher-z 95% interval tanh(atanh(r) +/- 1.96/sqrt(n-3)), descriptive only (assumes iid normal returns); with n <= 96 15m returns from about 1.4 days the interval is wide and no correlation is a stable estimate

aggregates.average_pairwise_weighted: sum_{i<j} w_i w_j rho_ij / sum_{i<j} w_i w_j
aggregates.rule: aggregates require EVERY pair; otherwise null with the pair coverage (fail closed); fewer than 2 positions -> UNAVAILABLE(fewer_than_two_positions)

btc.reference_choice_class: ASSUMED (BTC/USDT spot as the BTC market reference)
btc.direct_btc_weight: sum of |s_i| over positions whose base currency is BTC, divided by G (DERIVED)
btc.correlation_with_btc: RM0-CORR of each position with the reference (per position) and sum w_i rho_i,btc (requires every value)
btc.beta_to_btc: beta_i = cov(r_i, r_btc) / var(r_btc), sample (n-1) moments on pairwise-aligned returns, lookback 96, min_obs 48; portfolio beta = sum_i (s_i / G) beta_i; BTC-beta-equivalent notional = sum_i s_i beta_i
btc.naming_rule: correlation is never called beta; the three measures are reported separately
btc.insufficient: INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY is a legitimate output; an unknown beta is null, never 0

covariance.alignment: common bars where EVERY position has an RM0-RET return within the long lookback
covariance.condition: n_common >= max(min_obs_long, 5 x k), k = number of positions
covariance.outputs: portfolio_vol_proxy, diversification_ratio, euler risk contribution; all UNAVAILABLE(covariance_condition_not_met) otherwise
covariance.effective_bets: eigen / minimum-torsion effective number of bets is REFUSED in v1 (precision not supported by about 1.4 days of 15m data)

liquidity.time: snapshot time T with zero latency: book and depth are the PIT records at T. This is NOT an EXEC-* scenario (EXEC-BASE executes at T + 1 s, after the snapshot); EXEC-BASE stays an ASSUMED P2-X scenario
liquidity.liquidation_side: long -> sell into the displayed bids; conceptual short -> buy from the displayed asks
liquidity.per_position: tier, book state, spread_bps, book quote age, depth state, depth age, displayed side notional (all levels), utilization = n_i / displayed side notional, depth sufficiency (walk ok / notional_exceeds_displayed_depth / refused), touch half-spread cost n_i x spread_bps / 2 / 1e4
liquidity.aggregates: notional_weak_liquidity, notional_beyond_displayed_depth, notional_liquidity_unknown (book or depth INVALID or refused: kept separate, never counted as liquid or as zero), stale_depth positions (P2-X staleness DEGRADED/TOO_STALE) and depth_age_over_research_reference positions, weighted spread bps sum w_i spread_bps_i (requires every spread)
liquidity.weak_definition: a position is weak-liquidity when its depth walk is notional_exceeds_displayed_depth, or utilization or spread_bps reaches the POLICY research references (policy_v1.json)
liquidity.impact: market impact, realized slippage and fill probability are UNAVAILABLE always (P2-X truth boundary: no orders, no fills, no trade prints, no exchange event time on book/depth)

regime_primitives.status: measurement primitives only; NO named states in v1; never trading rules; research-only
regime_primitives.population: the universe epoch known at T
regime_primitives.direction: median over the universe of ln(close_E / close_{E-L}) for L in {16, 96} 15m bars (both bars present), plus the BTC reference value
regime_primitives.breadth: share of universe symbols with a positive 16-bar log return among those with a value
regime_primitives.volatility: median sigma_15m (short and long lookbacks) over the universe and the median of the per-symbol vol ratio
regime_primitives.liquidity_condition: median spread_bps at T over symbols with a non-INVALID book, share of the universe with a non-INVALID book, share with a non-INVALID depth state, median depth age
regime_primitives.coverage_rule: a universe median or share requires values for at least half of the universe, else INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY / UNAVAILABLE with the coverage

drawdown.input: an equity curve [(t_ms, equity, available_at_ms)] supplied by the caller; RM0 only accepts provenance SYNTHETIC_TEST_PATH and never manufactures a strategy equity curve
drawdown.pit: every point must have t_ms <= T and available_at_ms <= T, else the whole curve is refused (PITViolation)
drawdown.max_drawdown: max over t of 1 - E_t / max(E up to t)
drawdown.underwater_duration: current: t_last - t(last running peak) when E_last < peak, 0 otherwise; max: longest interval below the running peak (censored at t_last when still underwater, flagged)
drawdown.recovery_time: time from the max-drawdown trough to the first t with E_t >= the prior peak; null with reason not_recovered_by_snapshot_time when none
drawdown.velocity: max_drawdown / ((t_trough - t_peak) / 1 day) only when at least 3 points span the peak-to-trough interval; else UNAVAILABLE
drawdown.absent: no equity curve -> every drawdown metric UNAVAILABLE(no_equity_curve_supplied), never 0

diversification.rule: never a bare symbol count and never a single score: a profile of concentration (effective_n_notional, largest_share), correlation (average and max pairwise), BTC exposure (direct weight, portfolio beta, weighted correlation), volatility (high-vol share) and liquidity (weak-liquidity share), plus diversification_ratio = sum |s_i| sigma_i / sigma_p under the RM0-COV condition
diversification.limiting_factors: the research flags that fire on these components
diversification.refused: effective number of independent bets (eigen / torsion) is refused in v1

risk_contribution.covariance_euler: RC_i = s_i (Sigma s)_i / (s' Sigma s), sums to 1, only under the RM0-COV condition
risk_contribution.no_optimization: descriptive decomposition only; no weights are solved for, no target is set
